overview: This one-page file consists of a Department of State “List of Papers” entry recording a report sent from Taihoku on December 30, 1930, concerning earthquake effects on the large dam at Wushantou Reservoir, part of Taiwan’s Chianan Irrigation Project. Although the entry is filed under Formosan/Taiwanese agriculture and irrigation, its heading reads “Irrigation in Puerto Rico,” suggesting a clerical, indexing, or cross-filing anomaly; the substantive report itself is not present on this page.

people.name: Reed

subfiles.about: The entry records a full report on the effects of earthquakes upon the large dam at Wushantou Reservoir in Taiwan’s Chianan Irrigation Project.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State list sheet identifies a report dated December 30, 1930, sent from Taihoku by Reed. The report concerned earthquake effects on the principal dam and reservoir of the Chianan Irrigation Project. The sheet supplies only a brief filing description, not the report itself, and bears the apparently incongruous heading “Irrigation in Puerto Rico.”

interest: The page is useful as evidence that American officials were monitoring the vulnerability of major colonial-era irrigation infrastructure in Taiwan to earthquakes. It also preserves garbled or older romanizations of Taiwanese names, which can complicate archival discovery. The mismatch between the Puerto Rico heading and the Taiwan-related entry is especially interesting as an example of State Department filing practice, clerical error, or cross-referencing.
